title: orthrosanthus chimboracensis var. gladioloides
intro: Orthrosanthus chimboracensis var. gladioloides, commonly known as Gladiolus-like Orthrosanthus, is a flowering plant species in the family Iridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Orthrosanthus chimboracensis var. gladioloides include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
